thread:
sasha chen: quick sync request  noticed two usability issues in the Private setup wizard's networking step during the latest lab: 1) CIDR helper currently shows only IPv4 examples which confuses dual-stack users, and 2) the probe details drawer traps keyboard focus after you expand details and hit "Run all probes". need copy + a11y fixes.
maia nguyen: agree. for CIDR helper we should show both IPv4 and IPv6 inline but keep it concise: "CIDR (examples: 10.0.0.0/16 for IPv4, fd00::/8 for IPv6). If unsure, choose IPv4." also think moving long examples into a tooltip reduces clutter.
jamal taylor: probe focus trap is an ARIA manage-focus bug. current flow sets focus into the drawer and never restores it when probes finish. plan: capture document.activeElement before open, then restore focus after run completes. add aria-live on the streaming log area so SRs get updates without stealing focus.
andrew liu: for UX, make the drawer non-modal (no focus trap) and support Escape to close. snippet: \n\n```\nconst prev = document.activeElement;\nawait runAllProbes();\nprev?.focus?.();\n```\nalso move the contextual help link from the bottom of the step into the field label's right side so keyboard users hit it sooner.
sasha chen: maia, can you draft the tooltip microcopy? jamal: do we want streaming (polite) updates or only final status?
maia nguyen: tooltip draft: "Examples: IPv4  10.0.0.0/16; IPv6  fd00::/8. For mixed infra, enter your control-plane CIDR." inline helper: "Enter a network in CIDR notation (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16 or fd00::/8)."
jamal taylor: propose both: aria-live=\"polite\" region for incremental probe lines + assertive toast on final pass/fail. keeps screenreader noise low but gives live feedback. also add role=\"status\" on the final outcome.
design-bot: uploaded image: https://files.redwood.ai/ux/probe-drawer-trap-202604.png :eyes: shows focus stuck inside the expanded drawer after clicking run.
andrew liu: minor visual tweak  when probe details expand, add a visible focus ring on the close button so keyboard users know how to exit. also reduce bottom padding so "Run all probes" stays in view on small screens.
maia nguyen: microcopy for final result: "Connectivity check finished  3 of 4 checks passed. See details and suggested fixes." softer tone, clear CTA.
sasha chen: action items: maia will update inline copy + tooltip, jamal will implement focus-restore + aria-live + status role, and andrew will make UI tweeks (help link placement, visible focus on close, Esc handler). ill add a tiny e2e keyboard test to cover open/close/restore. target: patch release this sprint. thanks :thumbsup:
